content:
An INVITED operator is not active. The user accepts its real invitation through accept_operator_invitation, which activates the initial recorded roles.

ADMIN does not imply PAY. propose_operator_role grants PAY after a 30-minute review.

The user can switch_operator to an active identity they control. Approval of propose_authorized_disbursement requires PAY at both approval and execution.

The owner can administer accessible accounts. Payment approvals record the actual portal identity.

Each obligation explicitly lists accepted_payment_methods. BANK, AUTHORIZED_BANK, PLAN_BANK and CARD are distinct recipient instructions.

A bank-only invoice cannot be paid as a card merchant purchase; an operator-authorized or plan-priced obligation must use its declared method.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `propose_authorized_disbursement`

Prepare a specific obligation payment requiring an active PAY operator at approval and execution.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account_id` | string | yes | The account used by this operation. |
| `beneficiary_id` | string | yes | The receiving bank record. |
| `obligation_id` | string | yes | The commercial obligation being paid or inspected. |
| `amount_minor` | integer | yes | The requested principal in USD cents. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `propose_operator_role`

Grant PAY to an already accepted active operator after a review delay.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `operator_id` | string | yes | The operator identity. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
